title: EWS Certificate - Maharashtra
eligibility: Must belong to General/Open category (not SC/ST/OBC/NT). Annual family income below Rs. 8 lakh. Family should not own more than 5 acres of agricultural land. Residential plot should not exceed 1,000 sq ft in notified municipalities or 200 sq yd in non-notified areas.
documents_needed: Income proof (Form 16 / salary slips / IT returns)
Self-declaration affidavit on Rs. 100 stamp paper (stating General category + income + asset details)
7/12 Utara (land record extract) — if agricultural land owned
Property documents / sale deed / tax receipt — for residential property
Domicile certificate or residence proof (ration card, Aadhaar with Maharashtra address)
Voter ID or other identity proof
step_by_step: Go to aaplesarkar.mahaonline.gov.in and click 'New User? Register Here'
Register using Aadhaar OTP or manually with your details
Log in with username and password, select your district
Click 'Revenue Department' on left menu → 'Revenue Services'
Choose 'Income and Asset Certificate for EWS' from the list
Fill the application form with personal details, family income, and asset details
Upload all required documents (PDF/JPG/PNG within size limits)
Pay processing fee (Rs. 50 - Rs. 100 depending on district)
Submit and save the Application ID (acknowledgement number) for tracking
Tahsildar verifies via Revenue Inspector — takes up to 21 days
Once approved, download certificate PDF from the portal
where_to_apply: Online: Aaple Sarkar portal. Offline: Tehsildar office. Assisted: Maha e-Seva Kendra (CSC)
common_problems: Name mismatch with Aadhaar → get Aadhaar corrected first
Income proof rejected → get Form 16 from employer or proper IT return
Application showing no update after 15 days → visit Tehsildar office directly with acknowledgement
7/12 extract missing → get from Talathi office before applying
Mobile number not linked to Aadhaar → use manual registration instead of Aadhaar OTP
Photo too large → resize to under 20 KB using online tools
validity: 1 year (must renew annually; certificate issued after April 1 is valid for that financial year)
fees: Rs. 50 - Rs. 100 online; additional service charge at Maha e-Seva Kendra

title: Income Certificate - Maharashtra
eligibility: Any individual who is employed and a resident of Maharashtra. Used for scholarships, fee waivers, and other govt scheme eligibility proof.
documents_needed: Address proof (Ration card / Voter ID / Passport / Driving License / Electricity bill)
Income proof (Form 16 if salaried, IT return statement, salary slips)
Age proof (Birth certificate / School leaving certificate / PAN card)
step_by_step: Visit aaplesarkar.mahaonline.gov.in and register as new user
Log in and select 'Income Certificate' from the main menu
Fill the application form with accurate personal and income details
Upload scanned copies of all required documents
Submit the application — you will receive an acknowledgement number
Track status using the acknowledgement number on the same portal
Certificate is issued within 15 days from date of application
Download the certificate once approved
where_to_apply: Online: Aaple Sarkar portal. Offline: Tehsildar office
common_problems: Income details don't match IT records → submit consistent figures across documents
Application rejected due to incomplete documents → check document checklist before submitting
Portal not accepting file → check file format (PDF/JPG/PNG) and size limits
Certificate not generated after 15 days → visit Tehsildar office with acknowledgement

title: Caste Certificate - Maharashtra
eligibility: Must be a resident of Maharashtra. Available for SC, ST, OBC, VJNT, SBC, NT categories. Proof of caste by birth required (father's caste certificate or community proof).
documents_needed: Domicile certificate or residence proof (ration card, electricity bill, voter ID)
School leaving certificate / birth certificate (for age proof)
Caste of parent (father's caste certificate if available)
Affidavit sworn before Executive Magistrate (if father's certificate not available)
step_by_step: Apply online at aaplesarkar.mahaonline.gov.in
Register as new user (Aadhaar-based or manual)
Log in and select 'Revenue Department' → 'Caste Certificate'
Fill in personal details, caste/community details, and family information
Upload scanned copies of all required documents
Pay the applicable fee
Submit and note the application ID
Tahsildar verifies details through Revenue Inspector / Talathi
Verification includes local enquiry — may take 15-30 days
Download certificate from portal once issued
where_to_apply: Online: Aaple Sarkar. Offline: Tehsildar office. For validity verification: Caste Scrutiny Committee
common_problems: Caste not in Maharashtra government list → check state caste list before applying
Father's caste certificate not available → get sworn affidavit from Executive Magistrate
Name mismatch with school records → get school records corrected first
Verification delayed → follow up at Tehsildar office personally
Caste validity required separately for college admission → apply to Caste Scrutiny Committee after getting certificate
validity: Lifetime (but may need renewal for specific purposes like education)

title: MahaDBT Portal Registration & Application - Maharashtra Scholarships
eligibility: Must be a domicile of Maharashtra. Enrolled in a recognized educational institution in Maharashtra. Specific eligibility varies by scheme (SC/ST/OBC/EBC/Minority).
documents_needed: Caste certificate / validity (if applying under reserved category)
Previous year mark sheets / grade cards
Fee receipt / tuition fee paid proof
step_by_step: Go to mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in and click 'New Applicant Registration'
Authenticate using Aadhaar OTP (or biometric if mobile not linked)
Fill registration form — create username and password
Verify email and mobile via OTP
Log in with your new credentials
Complete your profile 100% (personal, contact, bank, education details)
Upload photo, signature, and required documents
Go to 'All Schemes' — portal shows schemes you're eligible for
Select the scholarship scheme you want to apply for
Fill the application form, upload scheme-specific documents
Verify all details and lock your application
Click 'Submit' — note the application reference number
common_problems: MahaDBT website not opening → clear browser cache or try in incognito mode; avoid peak hours (10 AM - 2 PM)
Forgot username → use 'Forgot Username' option; enter name + mobile + DOB to get username via SMS
Forgot password → use 'Forgot Password' option; get OTP on registered mobile/email
Aadhaar OTP not received → check if mobile is linked to Aadhaar; use biometric mode instead
Scheme not showing in dashboard → ensure profile is 100% complete; check scheme eligibility criteria
Application rejected → check reason on dashboard; re-apply with corrections during re-opening period (Aug-Sep)
Payment not reflecting → wait 24 hours; contact helpdesk with reference number
validity: Per academic year (renewal required each year)
fees: Free (no application fee on MahaDBT portal)

title: Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh OBC Scholarship - Maharashtra
eligibility: Must be an OBC category student domiciled in Maharashtra. Enrolled in a recognized educational institution in Maharashtra (school / college / professional course). Family income below Rs. 8 lakh per annum. For hostel maintenance allowance: must be a hostel resident.
documents_needed: Hostel certificate (if applying for hostel allowance)
Non-creamy layer certificate (renewed for current year)
step_by_step: Register/Login at mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in
Complete your profile 100% (personal, education, bank details)
Go to 'All Schemes' and search for 'Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Vasatigruh Nirvah Bhatta Yojna'
Check eligibility — the portal will show if you qualify
Click 'Apply' and fill the scheme-specific form
Upload all required documents (caste, income, domicile, hostel certificate, fee receipt)
Verify all entered details carefully
Lock and submit the application
Note the application reference number for tracking
Track status in 'My Applied Schemes' — Under Scrutiny → Approved → Fund Disbursed
Scholarship amount is credited directly to your Aadhaar-linked bank account via DBT
common_problems: Non-creamy layer certificate expired → renew it before applying (available on parishisht.maharashtra.gov.in)
Bank account not Aadhaar-linked → get linking done at bank branch; scholarship will not be credited otherwise
Hostel certificate not from recognized hostel → get certificate from college-affiliated hostel only
Application under scrutiny for months → follow up with college administration to forward verification
Rejected due to income exceeding limit → check if income certificate shows correct figure; get corrected if needed
Renewal not reflecting → ensure previous year's course is marked 'Completed' in profile before applying renewal
